verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents a concrete skill format: each skill is a directory with a `SKILL.md` file containing YAML frontmatter and markdown instructions. The docs explain how to build, test, and publish custom workspace or personal skills, and the `openclaw skills` CLI installs skills from local directories and offers check/workshop commands. Custom tools can also be wired in by connecting your own MCP server. Missing for 10: a documented authoring format/SDK for code plugins (plugin evidence covers only installing from ClawHub), and independent hands-on corroboration of building and loading a custom skill locally.
